pages.title: Spacetime Panel
pages.text: A panel of spacetime alloy whose surface seems to bend inward slightly, as if the wall behind it were further away than it is. It is cool, smooth and very faintly disorienting to look at for long. Its edges line up neatly in rows.
Made in a $(item)Stonecutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Block of Spacetime Alloy.
